MOLECULAR GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center
Department of Clinical Genetics

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

REFERRAL REASON
Diagnostic testing for breast cancer genetic susceptibility

METHODOLOGY
Next generation DNA sequencing with target capture hybridization was performed for comprehensive analysis of breast cancer susceptibility genes. The test includes sequence variant detection and read depth analysis for exon deletions/duplications detection.

Genes analyzed:
- BRCA1 (LRG_292t1)
- BRCA2 (LRG_293t1)
- PALB2 (LRG_308t1)
- CHEK2 (NM_007194.3)

Variant Filtering: Variants were filtered and analyzed using standard variant analysis software. All coding exons and flanking intronic sequences (±20bp) were evaluated.

RESULTS

BRCA1 gene: No pathogenic sequence variants detected
BRCA2 gene: No pathogenic sequence variants detected
PALB2 gene: No pathogenic sequence variants detected
CHEK2 c.1100delC variant (rs555607708): Not detected

Exon deletion/duplication analysis: No deletions or duplications detected in any of the analyzed genes

SUMMARY
No pathogenic sequence variants detected in BRCA1, BRCA2, or PALB2 genes. CHEK2 c.1100delC variant not detected. Testing included sequence variants and exon deletions/duplications screening.

CLINICAL INTERPRETATION
Patient unlikely to have pathogenic sequence variant in BRCA1, BRCA2 or PALB2 gene. CHEK2 c.1100delC variant not detected.

TECHNICAL NOTES
This assay detects >98% of pathogenic variants in the analyzed genes. The test is designed to detect single nucleotide variants, small insertions and deletions, and exon-level copy number changes. Large genomic rearrangements outside of exonic regions may not be detected. Variants in regulatory regions, deep intronic regions, or other non-coding regions are not evaluated. This test does not detect epigenetic changes or somatic mosaicism below the level of detection (~20%).

Reference sequences used:
- BRCA1: LRG_292t1
- BRCA2: LRG_293t1
- PALB2: LRG_308t1
- CHEK2: NM_007194.3

This test was developed and its performance characteristics determined by [redacted location] Medical Center Clinical Genetics Laboratory. It has not been cleared or approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
